description: The domain's task list: quests (concrete recommendations with implementation guidance and XP rewards) and issues (technical findings from the latest crawl with affected URLs). Use kind=quest or kind=issue; pass an id for full details of a single entry. Responses follow the account language (German by default).

domainId.description: Domain id of one of the user's projects, as returned by list_domains.

id.description: Id of a single entry for full details.

status.description: Only for kind=quest: OPEN, IMPLEMENTED, VERIFIED_SUCCESS, VERIFIED_PARTIAL, VERIFIED_NO_CHANGE, DISMISSED.

name: quests_and_issues
title: Quests and issues
